breaking_news.headline: Canada announces dollar-for-dollar retaliation after new 50% U.S. tariffs
breaking_news.summary: Canada said retaliatory tariffs on U.S. steel, electronics, dairy, appliances, agricultural equipment, pulp and paper and other products will begin September 8 after U.S.-Canada trade talks failed.
breaking_news.market_impact: Raises North American trade-policy risk and can pressure industrial, auto, materials and cross-border supply-chain sentiment.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Indirect negative for global risk appetite; monitor electronics supply-chain tariff spillovers and CAD/USD moves.

breaking_news.headline: Iran condemns new U.S. sanctions as Hormuz oil traffic remains severely constrained
breaking_news.summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is due to detail new Iran sanctions Monday. Reuters reported Strait of Hormuz traffic remains far below pre-war levels, preserving a large oil supply risk premium.
breaking_news.market_impact: Keeps crude oil and inflation risk elevated and can push long yields higher.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Negative for transport and energy-intensive margins; higher yields remain a valuation headwind for high-multiple technology shares.

breaking_news.headline: Wall Street rebounded Friday but ended the week lower
breaking_news.summary: S&P 500 +0.43%, Nasdaq +0.44%, Dow +0.98%; the weekly picture remained weaker as bond yields and oil stayed high.
breaking_news.market_impact: Friday rebound is tactical rather than a clean macro reset.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Positive opening impulse, but SOX weakness argues against assuming broad semiconductor strength.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: NVIDIA customers reportedly told AI-server prices may rise more than 15%
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Reuters cited a Bloomberg report that servers containing NVIDIA AI chips could see price increases above 15% in many cases as memory costs surge, affecting early-2027 systems including Vera Rubin and Grace Blackwell configurations.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Signals strong component cost pressure and continued scarcity in the AI infrastructure stack; pricing power can support revenue dollars but may raise customer ROI scrutiny.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Potentially positive revenue mix for TSMC, memory, AI server ODM, PCB, power and cooling, while higher system costs could shift order timing and supplier negotiations.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: NVIDIA Aug. 26 earnings remains the largest near-term AI catalyst
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: NVIDIA reports fiscal Q2 on August 26 as markets test whether AI infrastructure demand can absorb higher financing and component costs.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Major catalyst for semiconductor risk premium and hyperscaler capex expectations.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Highest sensitivity: TSMC, CoWoS, AI servers, networking, PCB, cooling and power.

narration_points: 今天是週日，市場行情仍以8月21日最後完整交易日為準。
美股週五反彈，但週線仍受到長債殖利率與油價高檔壓力。
NVIDIA客戶據報被告知部分AI伺服器明年價格可能上調超過15%，反映記憶體成本與AI基建供需仍緊。
加拿大宣布對美國新關稅採取對等反制，北美貿易摩擦重新升溫。
伊朗制裁與Hormuz油運限制讓能源通膨風險持續存在。
台股週一可受美股反彈支撐，但SOX未同步走強，AI供應鏈應以選股而非全面看多解讀。
本週焦點集中在8月26日PCE、GDP、耐久財與NVIDIA財報，以及Jackson Hole政策訊號。
